status: Unincorporated territory of the United States
name: Guam
blurb: A US island in Micronesia mixing Chamorro culture, beach resorts and WWII history.
cities: Hotel row on a calm reef lagoon, with snorkelling and duty-free malls.
The capital, with the Plaza de España, Latte Stone Park and Chamorro night markets.
Quiet villages, Spanish-era Umatac Bay and the War in the Pacific battle sites.
